features.title: Living on the edge
features.text: Daredevils leap into danger, using movement and maneuvers to set up attacks. A daring stunt can knock an enemy down or push them out of position.

features.title: Adrenaline
features.text: Starting a risky action grants adrenaline even if the roll fails. It powers special attacks until the start of the daredevil's next turn.
